doc.title: Monthly Updates [Sept]
doc.html:
INFO These update threads only contain major updates. If you're interested in seeing all minor changes you can follow our Commits Page on GitHub or Updates Channel in Discord.

Wiki Updates

  • FMHY.net URLs have been updated to make them look cleaner and easier to share or type.

  • Split AI Chatbots into Official Model, Multi-Model, and Specialized to make the section easier to navigate.

  • Added a QR Code Tools section to Internet.

  • Added an SAT Testing section to Educational.

  • Added an AI Coding Benchmarks section to AI.

  • Merged Quotes / Poetry into one section under Reading.

  • Debloated and reorganized the Translator section. Before vs. After

  • Debloated and reorganized the Image Generator section. Before vs. After

  • Debloated and reorganized the Hackintosh section. Before vs. After

  • Debloated and reorganized the Live Webcams section. Before vs. After

  • Debloated and reorganized the Resume / Portfolio section. Before vs. After

  • Debloated and reorganized the LaTeX Tools section. Before vs. After

  • Cleaned up formatting in the Image Gen Guide section. Before vs. After

  • Thank you to CY83R, AnarchyDr, Kiri, Hugo, and anyone else who helped organize or create sections this month.

Stars Added ⭐

  • Re-starred Copilot in Official Models and moved it to the #2 spot. It now has unlimited o4-mini and GPT-5 access.

  • Starred DeepL in Translators. Fast, accurate, and features flexible post-processing, making it ideal for production environments.

  • Starred UnionCrax in Game Downloading. Features fast hosts, pre-installs, and allows for requests.

  • Starred VORAPIS in YouTube Customization. Restores the classic layout and improves performance.

  • Starred WiiLink in Wii Homebrew. Restores functionality to Wii Channels that have been abandoned by Nintendo.

  • Starred AN1 in Android APKs. Features a large library of games, quick updates, and single-click downloads.

  • Starred Namida in Android Audio Players. Smooth, highly customizable, includes YouTube support, and features a nice UI.

  • Starred StartAllBack in System Tweaks. Restores Win10-style UI features in Win11 and improves overall responsiveness.

  • Starred Z.ai in AI Chatbots. Fast, unlimited, and performs well; it's one of the better open-source reasoning models available.

  • Starred GAM.ONL in Browser Emulators. Features a very nice UI and navigation system plus many consoles and games.

  • Starred the Vita Hacks Guide in PlayStation Homebrew. Well-respected, easy to follow, and highly recommended for anyone starting Vita modding.

  • Starred Subtitle Edit in Subtitle Tools. An easy-to-use, feature-rich, and well-maintained subtitle editor.

Things Removed

  • Unstarred ChatGPT; it currently has poor overall limits and reasoning quotas. It is no longer considered a top-tier free option compared to others.
